• Batman #8 and Nightwing #6: Haven't read any Monster Men yet (my monthly comic shipment will be coming tomorrow and won't include this week's books), but I'm pumped for the conclusion of the first stories in the Bat-titles leading into Monster Men.

  • Revolution #2: I like the idea that IDW is moving to a shared universe for most of their Hasbro line (no My Little Pony in there unfortunately) plus I'm always a sucker for a badass Optimus Prime cover

  • Amazing Spider-man #19: I'm actually getting more and more hopeful for the Dead No More/Clone Conspiracy story even though after all these years I still cringe at the mention of "clones". For all the shit I give Marvel for "One More Day," Dan Slott has basically been the writer on Amazing Spider-man (including a brief intermission for Superior Spider-man) for almost 9 years now and he's done some really stupendous work in that time.

Also, since I'm always talking about how awesome IDW Transformers is, the current Humble Books Bundle has a significant portion of the Transformers comics published by IDW.

It has the first and third mini-series (Infiltration and Devastation) which IDW published and the overwhelming majority of the two current ongoing series (only missing Dark Cybertron which was covered between issues 23 and 27 of both Robots in Disguise and More than Meets the Eye.) And that's all with only the $8 tier, since the $15 tier is the all the Revolution stuff published only in the last month or two.

If you want to dip your toes in to figure out if it's worth it, then for $8 this is absolutely worth it.

If you like what you see, then the glaring omissions include the 6 issue Escalation mini-series (between Infiltration and Devastation), All Hail Megatron (16 issues), the first regular series (which went 31 issues) and a number of the Spotlight issues (mostly the 4 part Revelation storyline, which set up a number of other stories in the various regular series).

And there are plenty of flavor series as well which aren't essential, but are just as awesome as hell. Such as Megatron Origin and the Autocracy/Primacy/Monstrosity trilogy.
